sub_site: amniotic fluid (second trimester amniocentesis and term caesarean delivery)

evidence.quote: Women who underwent amniocentesis for prenatal diagnosis were enrolled at 19 ~ 21 weeks of gestation in Peking University First Hospital
The 16S rRNA gene V3–V4 region was chosen for Illumina sequencing

controls.types: sampling blank (sterile saline); extraction blank; PCR/amplification NTC

evidence.quote: sterile saline solution collected at the same time as amniocentesis or cesarean section (sampling control, SC, n = 8), DNA extraction kit buffers obtained in the laboratory (extraction control, EC, n = 4)
The bacterial DNA of all the AF samples and control samples were assessed by 16S ribosomal RNA gene sequencing.
the sequence data were filtered by the following criteria: (1) absence in negative controls and the second trimester AF in cohort 1
bacterial DNA copy number was detected using TaqMan quantitative PCR of the V3–V4 regions of the 16S rRNA gene

notes: Cohort 1: 55 second-trimester + 55 delivery AF (healthy); cohort 2: 24 second-trimester AF with later infection-related adverse outcomes. Authors interpret second-trimester-specific genera (E0023-24) as systemic contamination: flagged Propionibacterium, Megasphaera, Prevotella, Sphingomonas; Listeria, Enterococcus, Streptococcus, Bacteroides were in both second-trimester (contamination) and delivery lists, recorded unflagged (judgement call). Cohort-2 genera filtered against controls. Conclusion: no microorganisms in healthy AF.
